subject.title: Add config flag to always show provider in model picker (not only on name collisions)

question: Should provider visibility in model pickers be solved by a new opt-in config flag, by changing the default display policy, or by folding provider labels into the broader runtime/auth-route picker metadata work?
rationale: The user friction is real, but OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config surface and related open PRs already explore runtime/auth-route labels on the same picker surface.

options.title: Choose one canonical picker policy first
options.body: Decide a shared default or hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if maintainers still want a per-user preference after that policy is clear.

options.title: Add one cross-surface opt-in flag
options.body: Accept the extra config surface and require a single documented schema path that applies consistently to Control UI and TUI with focused regression coverage.

options.title: Fold into runtime-label work
options.body: Route this through the existing provider/runtime/auth-label cluster so maintainers avoid parallel suffix and metadata systems.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical picker policy first
recommendation.body: Decide a shared default or hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if maintainers still want a per-user preference after that policy is clear.

likelyOwner.reason: Current release/config history and recent area ownership make this the best available routing candidate for the config/UX policy choice.
